Real humans. Actual replies.

Five paths depending on what you need. Every email is monitored by a real person on our team.

· PATH I ·

Support

Using the app? Stuck on something? Task rejected unfairly? Payout delayed?

teenlancer@funngro.com

RESPONSE IN UNDER 24 HOURS, USUALLY UNDER 4.

· PATH II ·

Brands & partnerships

Running a brand campaign? Looking for youth distribution? Want to pilot a CPA test?

hello@funngro.com

RESPONSE IN UNDER 1 BUSINESS DAY.

· PATH III ·

Press

Writing about Funngro or the youth economy? Need a founder quote, a stat, or our press kit?

hello@funngro.com

RESPONSE SAME DAY FOR ACTIVE STORIES.

Investors

Series A 2026. Institutional introductions welcome. Limited direct outreach.

hello@funngro.com
